mapper.update: UPDATE CAP_CAPITAL_INVESTMENT_PLAN_LN PL SET PL.ACTUAL_INVESTMENT_AMOUNT= CASE WHEN PL.PRJ_TYPE='PRJ_PROJECT' THEN ifnull ( ( SELECT SUM(CASH.RECEIVED_AMOUNT) FROM CON_CONTRACT CON JOIN CON_CONTRACT_CASHFLOW CASH ON CON.CONTRACT_ID=CASH.CONTRACT_ID AND CASH.CF_ITEM=0 WHERE PL.PLAN_LINE_ID=CON.PLAN_LN_ID),0) ELSE ifnull ( ( SELECT SUM(CASH.RECEIVED_AMOUNT) FROM FCT_CONTRACT CON JOIN FCT_QUOTATION_CASHFLOW CASH ON CON.CONTRACT_ID=CASH.CONTRACT_ID AND CASH.CF_ITEM=40 WHERE PL.PLAN_LINE_ID=CON.PLAN_LN_ID),0) END , PL.EXECUTE_STATUS=( CASE WHEN PL.EXECUTE_STATUS='CANCEL' OR PL.EXECUTE_STATUS='DELAY' THEN PL.EXECUTE_STATUS ELSE ( CASE WHEN PL.APPLY_INVESTMENT_AMOUNT= ( CASE WHEN PL.PRJ_TYPE='PRJ_PROJECT' THEN ifnull ( ( SELECT SUM(CASH.RECEIVED_AMOUNT) FROM CON_CONTRACT CON JOIN CON_CONTRACT_CASHFLOW CASH ON CON.CONTRACT_ID=CASH.CONTRACT_ID AND CASH.CF_ITEM=0 WHERE PL.PLAN_LINE_ID=CON.PLAN_LN_ID),0) ELSE ifnull ( ( SELECT SUM(CASH.RECEIVED_AMOUNT) FROM FCT_CONTRACT CON JOIN FCT_QUOTATION_CASHFLOW CASH ON CON.CONTRACT_ID=CASH.CONTRACT_ID AND CASH.CF_ITEM=40 WHERE PL.PLAN_LINE_ID=CON.PLAN_LN_ID),0) END) THEN 'EXECUTED' WHEN ( CASE WHEN PL.PRJ_TYPE='PRJ_PROJECT' THEN ifnull ( ( SELECT SUM(CASH.RECEIVED_AMOUNT) FROM CON_CONTRACT CON JOIN CON_CONTRACT_CASHFLOW CASH ON CON.CONTRACT_ID=CASH.CONTRACT_ID AND CASH.CF_ITEM=0 WHERE PL.PLAN_LINE_ID=CON.PLAN_LN_ID),0) ELSE ifnull ( ( SELECT SUM(CASH.RECEIVED_AMOUNT) FROM FCT_CONTRACT CON JOIN FCT_QUOTATION_CASHFLOW CASH ON CON.CONTRACT_ID=CASH.CONTRACT_ID AND CASH.CF_ITEM=40 WHERE PL.PLAN_LINE_ID=CON.PLAN_LN_ID),0) END) =0 THEN 'UNEXECUTED' ELSE 'PARTIAL_EXECUTED' END ) END ) WHERE PL.PLAN_LINE_ID =#{planLineId}

UPDATE CAP_CAPITAL_INVESTMENT_PLAN_HD HD SET HD.INVESTED_AMOUNT= ( SELECT nvl( SUM(LN.ACTUAL_INVESTMENT_AMOUNT),0) FROM CAP_CAPITAL_INVESTMENT_PLAN_LN LN WHERE LN.PLAN_HEAD_ID=HD.PLAN_HEAD_ID AND LN.EXECUTE_STATUS!='CANCEL'), HD.APPLY_INVESTMENT_AMOUNT_SUM= ( SELECT nvl( SUM(LN.APPLY_INVESTMENT_AMOUNT),0) FROM CAP_CAPITAL_INVESTMENT_PLAN_LN LN WHERE LN.PLAN_HEAD_ID=HD.PLAN_HEAD_ID AND LN.EXECUTE_STATUS!='CANCEL'), HD.PLAN_STATUS=( CASE WHEN ( SELECT nvl( SUM(LN.ACTUAL_INVESTMENT_AMOUNT),0) FROM CAP_CAPITAL_INVESTMENT_PLAN_LN LN WHERE LN.PLAN_HEAD_ID=HD.PLAN_HEAD_ID AND LN.EXECUTE_STATUS!='CANCEL')=0 THEN 'NOT' WHEN ( SELECT nvl( SUM(LN.ACTUAL_INVESTMENT_AMOUNT),0) FROM CAP_CAPITAL_INVESTMENT_PLAN_LN LN WHERE LN.PLAN_HEAD_ID=HD.PLAN_HEAD_ID AND LN.EXECUTE_STATUS!='CANCEL')< ( SELECT nvl( SUM(LN.APPLY_INVESTMENT_AMOUNT),0) FROM CAP_CAPITAL_INVESTMENT_PLAN_LN LN WHERE LN.PLAN_HEAD_ID=HD.PLAN_HEAD_ID AND LN.EXECUTE_STATUS!='CANCEL') THEN 'PARTIAL' ELSE 'FULL' END )
WHERE 1=1
AND HD.PLAN_HEAD_ID=#{planHeadId}
AND HD.PLAN_HEAD_ID= ( SELECT LN.PLAN_HEAD_ID FROM CAP_CAPITAL_INVESTMENT_PLAN_LN LN WHERE LN.PLAN_LINE_ID=#{planLineId})
